description: Curated image prompt and visual-style pipelines for ForkProbe v1.1. These candidates do not call image APIs directly; they generate prompt packages that can be rendered downstream in Codex or by an external image tool.

skills.name: baseline image prompt package
skills.summary_zh: 不使用专门图片 prompt skill，直接由主模型生成完整 prompt package，作为提示词基线。
skills.summary_en: No specialized image prompt skill; the main model generates a complete prompt package as the baseline.

skills.name: creative director image prompt
skills.author: ForkProbe
skills.summary_zh: 先拆解主体、场景、镜头、光线、材质、情绪和视觉叙事，再写成可渲染提示词。
skills.summary_en: Breaks the idea into subject, scene, camera, lighting, materials, mood, and visual story before writing the render prompt.

skills.name: style system prompt package
skills.author: ForkProbe
skills.summary_zh: 先建立可复用风格卡和系列化视觉规则，再输出适合多张图复用的提示词。
skills.summary_en: Builds a reusable style card and series-level visual rules before producing prompts that can scale across multiple images.

skills.name: prompt-as-code image package
skills.author: ForkProbe
skills.summary_zh: 输出结构化 JSON/YAML prompt，明确主体、风格、构图、参数建议和可变槽位，便于跨工具迁移。
skills.summary_en: Outputs structured JSON/YAML prompts with subject, style, composition, parameter notes, and reusable slots for cross-tool portability.

skills.name: reference-to-style prompt package
skills.author: ForkProbe
skills.summary_zh: 围绕参考图或竞品图提取风格语言、构图规律、材质光线和禁用元素，再生成新图提示词。
skills.summary_en: Extracts style language, composition patterns, materials, lighting, and forbidden elements from references before generating a new-image prompt.

skills.name: e-commerce product image prompt
skills.author: ForkProbe
skills.summary_zh: 面向电商主图、场景图、详情图和产品卖点图，强调商品清晰度、材质、场景可信度和平台可用性。
skills.summary_en: For e-commerce hero, lifestyle, detail, and benefit images; emphasizes product clarity, material fidelity, believable scenes, and platform readiness.

skills.name: poster / key visual prompt
skills.author: ForkProbe
skills.summary_zh: 面向海报 KV、活动视觉和品牌主视觉，强调中心视觉、层次、留白、标题区和传播冲击力。
skills.summary_en: For posters, campaign key visuals, and brand hero visuals; emphasizes focal image, hierarchy, whitespace, title-safe regions, and communication impact.

skills.name: social cover image prompt
skills.author: ForkProbe
skills.summary_zh: 面向小红书、短视频封面、社媒头图和内容配图，强调停留感、可读区、情绪钩子和移动端构图。
skills.summary_en: For Xiaohongshu/RedNote, short-video covers, social headers, and content thumbnails; emphasizes stopping power, readable zones, emotional hook, and mobile composition.

skills.name: PPT illustration prompt package
skills.author: ForkProbe
skills.summary_zh: 面向 PPT 插图、章节页视觉和汇报配图，强调信息辅助、低干扰、留白和与版式兼容。
skills.summary_en: For slide illustrations, section visuals, and presentation images; emphasizes information support, low distraction, whitespace, and layout compatibility.

skills.name: portrait / character prompt package
skills.author: ForkProbe
skills.summary_zh: 面向头像、人物设定和角色图，强调身份、姿态、镜头、服饰材质和一致性描述。
skills.summary_en: For portraits, persona images, and character concepts; emphasizes identity, pose, camera, wardrobe/materials, and consistency language.

skills.name: concept art prompt package
skills.author: ForkProbe
skills.summary_zh: 面向游戏、影视、世界观和概念设计，强调设定、场景逻辑、氛围、尺度和可扩展视觉语言。
skills.summary_en: For game, film, worldbuilding, and concept design; emphasizes setting, scene logic, atmosphere, scale, and extensible visual language.
